alternatives.name: CORE_RUNTIME_IBKR_VENDOR_SDK
tradeoffs: Would place ib_insync/ibapi sockets inside the stdlib foundation; ib_insync is already a prohibited pattern under phase0-dependency-lock.json.
Would break Phase 0 import analysis and replay determinism for the second live provider.

alternatives.name: PROCESS_BOUNDARY_OBSERVATIONAL_ADAPTER
tradeoffs: Extends the ADR-LIVE-001 process boundary to a second provider (Interactive Brokers) without changing its terms.
Client Portal Gateway REST collection is stdlib-only; the TWS socket collector stays in an out-of-repo venv process.
Automated SRP/TOTP gateway login follows an undocumented IBKR protocol and may break on vendor changes; manual browser login remains the fallback runbook.
Live bytes remain outside admitted research datasets until a later ADR.

negative: Ordinary CI must remain green with no IBKR Gateway installed or reachable.
Captured IBKR observations are not automatically admitted research datasets.
Delayed L1 (15-20 minutes) and entitlement-gated historical surfaces bound what can be characterized for free.
Headless login automation depends on an unofficial protocol; credential handling risk is accepted by the principal and confined to .private/.
positive: Free delayed quotes, historical bars, option chains, scanners, and own-account portfolio state become characterizable through one governed observational boundary.
Rate-limit compliance (10 req/s global token bucket, historical pacing, penalty-box backoff) is enforced client-side and unit-tested offline.
Vendor SDKs stay outside the CPython 3.11 stdlib foundation; tools processes cross into src only as serialized JSONL captures.

decision.summary: Extend ADR-LIVE-001's read-only observational boundary to Interactive Brokers as the second characterized provider. The local Client Portal Gateway (https://127.0.0.1:5000/v1/api) and, in a later stage, the IB Gateway desktop TWS socket (127.0.0.1:4001/4002) are optional out-of-src processes behind IMP_IBKR_LIVE-style fail-closed gates. Canonical core consumes serialized events only. Capture is not admission. Paper and live execution remain forbidden.
decision.title: IBKR Gateway observational market-data boundary (read-only)

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: This ADR does not authorize paper execution, live order submission, unlock_trade equivalents, fund movement, paid market-data purchases, options/futures entitlement changes, crypto research implementation (PI14+), prediction-market integration, automatic admission of live observations as research datasets, or any write/order endpoint usage against /iserver.

security.credential_store: .private/providers.env gitignored; secrets redacted from all journals and logs
security.transport_tls: self-signed localhost certificate pinned to loopback hosts only; non-loopback hosts rejected unconditionally in code
